pages.name: Nimzowitsch Defense: Pseudo-Spanish Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 called the bishop's pressure a pin (the d7-pawn shields e8); plan 3's ...b5 depended on Ba4 being written into Black's plan. Rewrote plans 2 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Nimzowitsch Defense: Scandinavian Variation, Advance Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 played ...Qb6 through the c7-pawn; plan 2 and the overview offered ...c5 with the c6-knight blocking it. Rewrote overview and plans 1, 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Nimzowitsch Defense: Scandinavian Variation, Bogoljubow Variation, Heinola-Deppe Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 2 wrote the knight route Ne2-f4 ambiguously. Rewrote plan 2 (after 4.dxe5 d4, the c3-knight via e2); British spelling.

pages.name: Nimzowitsch Defense: Scandinavian Variation, Bogoljubow Variation, Richter Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 2 had Black recapturing ...Nxf3 (it is White who recaptures on f3). Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Nimzowitsch Defense: Scandinavian Variation, Bogoljubow Variation, Vehre Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 challenged an e5-pawn that isn't there with ...h6 and ...g5; plan 3 read d6 as a move. Rewrote plans 2 and 3 (reviewer: plan 3 rejected once as vague, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Nimzowitsch Defense: Scandinavian Variation, Exchange Variation
pages.notes: The overview and plan 1 said Nf3 gains time against the queen (it doesn't attack d5); plan 1 also read g5 as a move. Rewrote overview and both plans (reviewer: first draft rejected for leaving d4 hanging, revised to Nf3 first, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Nimzowitsch Defense: Scandinavian Variation, Exchange Variation, Marshall Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 2 read d6 as a move; plan 3 played c3 with the knight on c3. Rewrote overview and plans 2 and 3 around 4...Qxd4; British spelling.

pages.name: Owen Defence: Matinovsky Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 sent the queen to h4 through the e7-pawn; plan 2 played fxg6 before ...g6. Rewrote overview (the gambit is unsound after 6...Bg7 7.Qf5) and both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Owen Defence: Matovinsky Gambit Accepted
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed a knight f3-g5 with no knight on f3; plan 2 used a g-file closed by the g6-pawn. Rewrote plans 1 and 2 (reviewer: plan 1 rejected once for missing 7.Qf5, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Owen Defense: Matovinsky Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 castled with the g2-bishop covering f1 and h1; plan 2 spoke of an extra exchange not yet won. Rewrote plans 1 and 2; British spelling.
